requirements.title: A primary is one of eleven expression atoms
requirements.definition: The syntactic class primary is exactly one of: literal-constant, designator, array-constructor, structure-constructor, enum-constructor, enumeration-constructor, function-reference, type-param-inquiry, type-param-name, parenthesized expr, or conditional-expr. The alternatives' internal formation and semantics remain with their owning subclauses.

requirements.title: A type-param-name primary names a type parameter
requirements.definition: When the R1001 type-param-name alternative is used, the name shall be the name of a type parameter. An ordinary object, component, procedure, or undeclared name does not satisfy this constraint merely because it has identifier spelling.

pending.declared-type-parameter-name: PENDING positive-control source shape inside a parameterized derived-type definition using declared type parameter n as a primary in a specification expression and checking a component bound against integer literal n's value through a valid constructor. The oracle is the declared literal parameter value; 7.5.3.1 owns the type-parameter declaration.
pending.ordinary-name-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape in a context where the grammar path is the type-param-name primary within a derived-type definition, using an ordinary accessible name that is not a type parameter. Repair changes only the declaration to make the name a type parameter and then observes the literal bound, isolating C1001 rather than R1001 designator admission.
pending.undeclared-name-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape using an undeclared identifier as a type-param-name primary in a derived-type parameter expression, with all other declarations valid. Repair declares the same identifier as an INTEGER LEN type parameter with a literal value, so the violation is attributable to C1001 name status, not to malformed syntax.

requirements.title: A primary designator is not a whole assumed-size array
requirements.definition: When the R1001 designator alternative is used as a primary, that designator shall not be a whole assumed-size array. Element, section with explicit upper bound, or non-assumed-size whole-array designators are outside this prohibition when otherwise valid.

requirements.title: A parenthesized expr primary is not a procedure-pointer-valued function reference
requirements.definition: For the R1001 parenthesized expr alternative, the contained expr shall not be a function reference that returns a procedure pointer. Other parenthesized expressions remain admitted when their contained expression is valid.

This distinguishes data pointer results from procedure pointer results while citing pointer-result owners.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_098.json reads all50 original base units and131 fine units of the 10.1.1 and 10.1.2 expression chain, derives the precedence structure independently from the grammar, and verifies all502 grammar heads. The derived chain is primary, then defined unary, then power, then multiply and divide, then unary plus and minus, then binary plus and minus, then concatenation, then a single relation, then NOT, AND, OR and finally EQV and NEQV, with defined binary operators lowest; the catalogue text matches that chain at that granularity. Five blocking findings were raised and closed before this record. Three replaced oracles that could not work: a literal value cannot observe the grouping of an associative operator, and an execution-path oracle cannot observe AND grouping because the standard does not require short-circuit evaluation. One moved a defined-binary rejection from R1023 syntax to the applicability and generic-resolution owners 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2. The fifth corrected the replacement text itself, which had claimed unobservability too broadly: grouping is unobservable only for intrinsic operands, while a non-associative defined extension of the same operator symbol makes it observable by value, and that route is now recorded as the concrete future shape. Expression interpretation, evaluation and constant expressions remain owned by 10.1.3 through 10.1.12 and intrinsic assignment by the registered 10.2.1.3. All facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
